history.p: "Dryaden's Bryllup" was a great succes during Hartmann's lifetime. It was also performed in Germany, and the esteemed Leipziger music magazine "Signale für die musikalische Welt" printed a very favourable comment.

incipText.p: Du bringer Bud mig fra Olympens Konge?
Du bringst mir Botschaft von Olymps Beherrscher?

expression.label: No. 1

incipText.p: Snart, I Smaa, vi her kan hvile
Bald, Ihr Kleinen, könnt Ihr ruhen

expression.tempo: Moderato - Allegretto grazioso - Allegretto poco agitato - Allegretto agitato

expression.label: No. 2
expression.title: Duet

incipText.p: Fremad! Hør, med sagte Susen
Vorwärts! Hör, der Baüme Säuseln

expression.tempo: Moderato - Moderato assai - Moderat più moto - Allegro agitato

incipText.p: Hil Apollo! herlig steg fra Oven ned
Heil Apollo! von den hohen Hallen
Der er Phantasus, min lille Tjener
Da ist Phantasus, mein kleiner Bote
Gjennem Skovens dybe Stilhed
Durch die Stille des Walds
Du vor straalende Drot
Unser strahlender Fürst
Fornemmer Du Nymphernes Ord?
Erfreuet der Klang nicht dein Ohr?
Her er Nectarens skummende Bæger
Dieser Becher voll schäumenden Nectars
O faure Lyra! sidste Trøst i Nøden
O traute Lyra! letzter Trost im Tode!
Jeg skal bort fra Livet
Ich soll fort vom Leben

expression.label: No. 9

incipText.p: Fra hendes Læbe Sjælen bort er flygtet
Von ihrer Lippe schon entweicht die Seele

expression.tempo: L'istesso tempo - più moto - Allegro moderato

incipText.p: Nu flygter Dagens Glands
Nun schwindet hinter Wald

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in black library binding with the monogram of King Frederik IX. At the end paste-down inscribed: "Opført 14 Maj 1900 i Musikforeningen / ved J.P.E. Hartmann Mindefest / Opført i Musikforeningen / 31 okt / og d. 2 Nov. 1905 (Hartmann 100 Aar Fødselsdag.)". Written in brown ink with additions in red and purple ink (the German text), pencil and blue crayon. Paper: 21 staves. Paginated on top and bottom until p. 27 (end of "Indledning"). Between pp. 27 and 28 two blank pages. The pagination at the bottom of the pages continues, whereas the pagination on top of the pages starts on a fresh. On p. 195 two bars cancelled in pencil. On p. 28 "11/6 58", on p. 204 signed and end dated "I:P:E:Hartmann / 3 Decbr. 1858."
1 bifolio. Written in brown ink. Paper: 14 staves. At the end of the music added in pencil in foreign hand: "Mai 1859" and "fra I.P.E. Hartmann." Last page blank.

annot.p: Master for the private print with a different text. Piano version with text between staves.
